title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on the Application by People's Courts of the Supreme People's Court's Provisions on Several Issues concerning the Trial of Enterprise Bankruptcy Cases in the Trial of Enterprise Bankruptcy Cases
keywords_en: bankruptcy; guarantee; people's court hearing enterprise bankruptcy cases; concerning the hearing of enterprise bankruptcy cases
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on the Application of the Supreme People's Court's
"Regulations on Several Issues Concerning the Trial of Enterprise Bankruptcy Cases"
by People's Courts in the Trial of Enterprise Bankruptcy Cases

Fa [2002] No. 273

To: Higher People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army; and the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the Higher People's Court of the Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region:

The "Regulations on Several Issues Concerning the Trial of Enterprise Bankruptcy Cases" (hereinafter referred to as the "Regulations") of the Supreme People's Court have been adopted at the 1232nd meeting of the Judicial Committee of the Supreme People's Court and shall come into effect on September 1, 2002. In order to correctly apply the "Regulations" in the trial of enterprise bankruptcy cases, the following matters are hereby notified:

1. People's courts at all levels shall earnestly organize judicial personnel to study the "Regulations", deeply understand their meaning, accurately grasp the spirit of the judicial interpretation, and fully recognize the important role of the "Regulations" in regulating enterprise bankruptcy conduct, protecting the lawful rights and interests of creditors and debtors, preventing false bankruptcy and true debt evasion, establishing social credit, maintaining socioeconomic order, and promoting the development of the socialist market economy.

2. After a party submits an enterprise bankruptcy application to a People's Court, the case-filing division shall receive the relevant application materials, determine the case number, and transfer the relevant application materials to the trial division handling enterprise bankruptcy cases. That trial division shall decide whether to accept the party's application in accordance with the relevant provisions of the "Regulations".

3. Where an enterprise bankruptcy applicant files an appeal with the People's Court at the next higher level in accordance with the provisions of paragraph 2 of Article 13 and paragraph 3 of Article 14 of the "Regulations", the case shall be tried by the trial division of the higher People's Court that handles enterprise bankruptcy cases.

4. Where a party to an enterprise bankruptcy case petitions the People's Court at the next higher level in accordance with the provisions of Article 38 and paragraph 2 of Article 44 of the "Regulations", the case shall be tried by the trial division of the higher People's Court that handles enterprise bankruptcy cases.

5. In accordance with the provisions of Article 104 of the "Regulations", where the Supreme People's Court discovers that a People's Court at a lower level, or a higher People's Court discovers that a People's Court at a lower level, has made an erroneous ruling in the enterprise bankruptcy proceedings, the case shall be tried by the trial division handling enterprise bankruptcy cases of the Supreme People's Court or the higher People's Court.

6. In the process of implementing the "Regulations", People's Courts at all levels shall pay attention to strengthening investigation and research, summarizing trial practice experience, and earnestly ensuring the effective implementation of the "Regulations".

December 26, 2002
